# Miauterm 0.1.9-coral

This is a maintenance release for the experimental ARM64 build.

## Changes

- Updated the launcher artwork for adaptive Android icons.
- Improved validation for copied local server links and added regression coverage for supported URL schemes.
- Updated the Debian welcome README to reflect the current app version, network behavior, and package setup instructions.
- Removed an unused in-app bug report generator and its obsolete resources.
- Cleaned compiler warnings in touched Android code and refreshed CI action pins.
- Added and corrected regression checks for backup handling, rootfs validation, and local server links.

The GitHub Actions release workflow runs the project checks, builds the signed ARM64 APK, and verifies the package before publishing it. Device-specific Debian and package behavior can still vary.
